description: Hold-out genuine case, written blind from the brief's family description. The message is simulated and the people in it are illustrative. A buyer with an open dispute says the parcel came late and damaged, and offers to settle. The photo is an illustrative drawing.

messages.subject: About my PayPal dispute for KIK-1032
messages.body: I opened a PayPal dispute because my laundry hamper hadn't arrived. It has now arrived, but the lid is cracked (photo attached). I'm happy to close the dispute if you refund $30 for the damage.
